1800 GOT JUNK Los Angeles Prices and Discounts

Whether you’re clearing out a garage, renovating a kitchen, or just tired of the clutter, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? is the go‑to service for many Angelenos. But before you pick up that phone, you probably want to know exactly how much it will cost and whether there are any savings you can snag. In this guide we break down the pricing structure, typical rates in the Los Angeles area, and the best ways to grab discounts without sacrificing service quality.

How 1-800-GOT-JUNK? Calculates Its Prices

The company uses a straightforward, volume‑based pricing model. Rather than charging by weight or the hour, a crew measures the amount of space your junk occupies in their truck. Here’s what that looks like in practice:

  • Truck Size Matters: A standard 14‑foot truck holds roughly 6–7 cubic yards of junk. Most residential jobs fit in one truck, while larger projects may need a second load.
  • Flat‑Rate Quotes: After a quick on‑site or virtual assessment, you’ll receive a flat‑rate price that covers labor, disposal fees, and insurance.
  • No Hidden Fees: The quote you get is the amount you’ll pay—there’s no surprise per‑item charge or mileage surcharge for typical LA distances.

Because the pricing is based on volume, the best way to keep costs low is to be strategic about what you load onto the truck. Items that take up a lot of space but have little weight (like old mattresses or bulky furniture) can drive the price up faster than dense, compact items (like bricks or concrete).

Typical 1-800-GOT-JUNK? Prices in Los Angeles

Los Angeles is a massive market, and prices can vary slightly depending on the neighborhood and the time of year. Below is a snapshot of average costs you’ll see when you request a quote:

Job Size Average Cost (USD) What Fits in One Truck?
Small (1/2 truck) $149 – $179 1–2 large appliances, a few pieces of furniture, boxes
Medium (1 full truck) $199 – $239 3–4 large sofas, a mattress, a fridge, several boxes
Large (1.5–2 trucks) $299 – $399 Whole house clean‑out, multiple rooms, large yard debris

These figures are averages; your exact quote will depend on the specific items you need removed and how tightly you can pack them. Remember, the price you see online often includes a small “service fee” that covers the crew’s travel time within the greater Los Angeles area.

Current Discounts & Promotions in LA

Everyone loves a good deal, and 1-800-GOT-JUNK? frequently runs promotions that can shave 10–20% off the standard price. Here are the most common ways to score a discount:

Seasonal Sales

  • Spring Clean‑Out Sale: Typically runs from March to May. Customers can claim a 15% discount by mentioning the “Spring Clean” promo code.
  • Summer Move‑Out Special: From June to August, a “Summer Move” coupon reduces the price by up to $30 on medium‑size jobs.

Referral Rewards

If a friend or neighbor has already used 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, you can both earn $25 off your next service when they refer you. The referral code is automatically applied when you schedule online, but it never hurts to double‑check with the dispatcher.

Military & Senior Discounts

Active‑duty military personnel, veterans, and senior citizens (65+) are eligible for a flat 10% discount on any job size. Just have your ID ready when you request the quote.

Corporate & Real‑Estate Partnerships

Many property managers and real‑estate firms have negotiated bulk‑rate agreements with 1-800-GOT-JUNK?. If you’re a landlord or work for a real‑estate agency, ask about a partnership discount—these can be as high as 25% off the standard rate.

How to Maximize Savings Before You Call

Even before you dial, there are a few proactive steps you can take to lower your bill:

  • Do a DIY Sort: Separate items you can donate (like gently used furniture) from truly junk. The less volume you need the truck to carry, the cheaper the job.
  • Measure Large Items: Grab a tape measure and note the dimensions of bulky pieces. When you give the estimate, you’ll have concrete numbers to discuss.
  • Schedule During Off‑Peak Hours: Early weekday mornings (8 am–10 am) often have more crew availability and may qualify for a small “off‑peak” discount.
  • Combine Jobs: If you have multiple clean‑outs in the same neighborhood, bundle them into one appointment. The crew can handle everything in one trip, saving you travel fees.
  • Check for Promo Codes: A quick Google search for “1-800-GOT-JUNK Los Angeles promo code” before you request a quote can uncover hidden savings.

When you’re ready, use the CTA below to lock in your quote and any applicable discount.

What to Expect on the Day of Service

Understanding the process helps you feel confident that you’re getting value for your money. Here’s a step‑by‑step rundown of a typical 1-800-GOT-JUNK? appointment in Los Angeles:

  1. Arrival: A crew of two professionals shows up at the scheduled time, wearing branded uniforms and carrying all the tools they need.
  2. Assessment: They quickly verify the volume of junk with you, confirming the final price before loading begins.
  3. Loading: Items are carefully loaded onto the truck to maximize space. If something won’t fit, the crew will discuss alternatives (e.g., a second load or a different disposal method).
  4. Cleanup: After loading, the crew sweeps the work area, leaving it as clean as—or cleaner than—it was before they arrived.
